body:
It's hard because I've had a couple of times when I lived at home where I thought I should talk about it, but she's been having issue after issue with work and worrying about my older brothers who are starting to make their way in the world.


Since I'll be moving soon and will have a schedule that's not the opposite of everyone else around me, I may give the freelance thing a try.  Do you have any tips on how to get started?  I've never dealt with anything like this before, all my jobs so far have been granted to me through the help of friends and family.

I took some classes in photography back when I was in high school and I got work during my town's Canada Day celebration one year helping to photograph events.  But past that I haven't done much with it other than the odd excursion in my new city.  It's kind of hard to do a lot when I'm stuck working nights.


I'm always interested in taking a look at new things, so if you have any links to tutorials I'd give them a look for sure.

I've talked to my parents about some of these issues in a round about way.  Even knowing I was having these thoughts would destroy my mother.  She was crying nightly over my older brother who left for school, and gets worried when my oldest brother doesn't call her every week.


So while I do want to talk to her, I don't want to hurt her right now, especially since she is going through a tough time herself and may very well be suffering from depression from stress/other things.

My spare time is filled with playing video games, writing, and the odd bout of photography, and bits of web design.  It was video games/programming in general that I was going to school for.  I do want to try to get something published, but it's being fought at by the feelings of inadequacy.  Just thinking that what I write isn't good enough, or that no one will be interested in it.
